# Luque et al. 2025 reduced spectra

Source: Zenodo [10.5281/zenodo.15463903](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.15463903) (v2, CC-BY-4.0), supplement to
Luque et al., "Insufficient evidence for DMS and DMDS in the atmosphere of K2-18 b" ([arXiv:2505.13407](https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.13407)).
Only the `transmission_spectra/*/*.csv` files were extracted (the zip is 2.9 GB, mostly retrieval outputs). Unmodified.

Instruments: NIRISS/SOSS (R~100), NIRSpec/G395H NRS1+NRS2 (R~200), MIRI/LRS (R~70).
Reductions: exoTEDRF, Eureka!, SPARTA. Columns: `wavelength` (um), `dppm` (ppm), `dppm_err` or `dppm_err_neg/pos`.
